attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file RI state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "RI" streq } over if
apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "RI" streq } over if

action_details.action_dsl: add "RI filing required - physical nexus" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "RI filing required - physical nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: add "RI filing required - economic nexus" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "RI filing required - economic nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "RI - no nexus, no filing required. Any estimated payments would be refunded." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvi /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvi /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "RI - no nexus, no filing required. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate RI state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus with RI; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate RI state additions and subtractions
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0; add "RI income adjustments calculated. Additions may include: Interest on U.S. government obligations, IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction, Federal bonus depreciation not allowed by RI. Subtractions may include: Interest on Rhode Island state and municipal obligations, Capital gains on certain qualified Rhode Island investments, Rhode Island net operating loss deduction. Reference: RI Form RI-1120C Instructions, R.I. Gen. Laws 44-11-11" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvi /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvi /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "RI income adjustments calculated. Additions may include: Interest on U.S. government obligations, IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction, Federal bonus depreciation not allowed by RI. Subtractions may include: Interest on Rhode Island state and municipal obligations, Capital gains on certain qualified Rhode Island investments, Rhode Island net operating loss deduction. Reference: RI Form RI-1120C Instructions, R.I. Gen. Laws 44-11-11" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0; add "RI - no nexus, no adjustments" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvi /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvi /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "RI - no nexus, no adjustments" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate RI state corporate income tax. Applies 7% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus with RI; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate RI tax at 7% flat rate
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = apportionment.state_taxable_income * apportionment.ri_state_tax_rate; set apportionment.state_tax = the maximum of (apportionment.state_tax - apportionment.state_credits) and (0.0); set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax; add "RI tax calculated at 7% flat rate. Reference: R.I. Gen. Laws 44-11-2" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income apportionment.ri_state_tax_rate fmul cvi /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_tax apportionment.state_credits - 0.0 fmax cvi /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax - cvi /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "RI tax calculated at 7% flat rate. Reference: R.I. Gen. Laws 44-11-2" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "RI - nexus but no taxable income. RI NOL carryforward rules may apply. Reference: R.I. Gen. Laws 44-11-11" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvi /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvi /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "RI - nexus but no taxable income. RI NOL carryforward rules may apply. Reference: R.I. Gen. Laws 44-11-11" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "RI - no nexus, no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvi /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvi /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "RI - no nexus, no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto
